subject.title: improve(android): move Wear agent, session, and model pickers to Home

question: Should Wear OS permanently replace the separate Agent and Session pages with compact Home controls and ship the capability-gated model-selection companion protocol?
rationale: The implementation and proof support the proposed behavior, but page removal and the new cross-version companion contract are product choices rather than a mechanical defect repair.

options.title: Approve the Home workflow
options.body: Accept compact Home controls as the supported Wear context UX, with capability gating preserving older Phone compatibility.

options.title: Retain separate context pages
options.body: Keep the existing Agent and Session pages and narrow or close this PR if their discoverability remains the preferred Wear navigation model.

recommendation.title: Approve the Home workflow
recommendation.body: Accept compact Home controls as the supported Wear context UX, with capability gating preserving older Phone compatibility.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the PR and authored the recent hardening commits for this exact Phone/Wear state path.
